FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 308
Committee: Constitution, Campaigns and Sponsor: Representative Jim Carns
Elections
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 03/03/2025
House Bill 308 as introduced could reduce election expenses paid from the State General Fund
by an estimated $750,000 to $1,350,000 over each 4-year election cycle, beginning in fiscal year
2026 by no longer requiring the judges of probate to publish registered voter lists in a newspaper
when the cost exceeds $40,000.
